attested.note: The listing of every 5-set of two-ququint stabilizer states whose span contains |T5>^2, one per orbit of the unitary symmetry group, lives in the stored batch outputs under research/t5q_m2_rank5/results/ (74 batches, 155,422 pivot-partner units, every unit run, 0 undecided, one hit: the five Z(x)Z eigensectors, a set fixed by the group). The enumeration was not re-run under the budget. The certificate re-enumerates the plan, re-runs the exact k = 1..4 censuses, verifies the hashes and geometry of every output, re-decides the stored hit, fails on any undecided unit, re-runs two batches from scratch (seed 20261001: batches 12 and 47), and then runs the exact lift decision of research/t5_m3_lift/lift.py on the listed set. Completeness rests on the stored outputs and on research/t5q_m2_rank5/batch.py, which regenerates any batch (batch.py K), under the modular assumption every kernel census of the project makes: a member whose image is nonzero over Q(zeta_5) is nonzero modulo 65521. An independent re-run of all 74 batches on 2026-10-02 (research/t5_m3_lift/results/pod/census/) reproduced every deterministic hash; it is recorded in provenance.compute and does not change the tier.
